job.job_description:
This role sits within Engineering Governance supporting Network Engineering platforms and strategic initiatives. The primary purpose is to design, develop, enhance and maintain scalable enterprise-grade full-stack web applications using Django, Django REST Framework (DRF) and React. The engineer will build API-first architectures, modern user experiences, high-performance data services and integration-heavy platforms supporting telecom engineering and operational processes. Experience in geospatial systems and optical or packet telecommunications is highly desirable.




The successful candidate should demonstrate a modern engineering mindset, effectively leveraging AI-powered development tools and practices to enhance productivity, code quality, and solution delivery.




What you will do

Design, develop, deploy and maintain enterprise-grade full-stack web applications.
• Design scalable backend services using Python, Django and DRF.
• Build modern React applications and reusable UI components.
• Design RESTful APIs and integration frameworks.
• Implement authentication, authorization and secure application design.
• Architect local, global and server-state management strategies.
• Develop data-intensive solutions, dashboards and reporting capabilities.
• Conduct code reviews, technical design reviews and mentoring.
• Drive CI/CD, testing automation and engineering best practices.



Key Performance Indicators
• Timely delivery of committed milestones.
• Software quality, maintainability and platform reliability.
• Application performance and scalability metrics.
• Stakeholder satisfaction and business value delivery.
• Engineering standards compliance.
• Data accuracy and operational efficiency improvements.




What we're looking for

Expereinced in  software engineering experience.

Backend: Python, Django, Django REST Framework, REST APIs, JWT, OAuth2, RBAC, Celery, Redis, Django Channels, FastAPI exposure, Pydantic, API design and optimization.

Frontend: React.js, JavaScript ES6+, TypeScript, HTML5, CSS3, Hooks, Redux Toolkit, React Query/TanStack Query, Context API, Zustand, API-driven UI design, scalable frontend architecture.

State Management Expertise: Strong understanding of Local State, Global State and Server State management strategies.

AI-Driven Development: Hands-on experience leveraging AI-powered development tools (GitHub Copilot, Microsoft Copilot, Cursor, ChatGPT/LLM-based assistants or equivalent) to accelerate software development, code optimization, test automation, debugging, documentation, rapid prototyping, and delivery of high-quality backend and frontend solutions. Exposure to integrating AI/LLM capabilities into enterprise applications.

Databases: PostgreSQL, Oracle, MySQL, query optimization, indexing, large-scale data handling.

DevOps: Git, GitLab, Jenkins, SonarQube, Docker, CI/CD. Exposure to Kubernetes and cloud platforms preferred.

Architecture: Distributed systems, microservices, caching, fault tolerance, observability and performance engineering.

Preferred Domain Experience: GIS/Geospatial systems, spatial analytics, telecom OSS/BSS, optical networks, packet networks, inventory and capacity management platforms.

Added Advantage: Kafka, RabbitMQ, GraphQL, cloud-native architectures.




Person Specification

Strong software engineering and architecture mindset.
• Exceptional analytical and problem-solving skills.
• Strong communication and stakeholder management skills.
• Ownership, accountability and leadership capabilities.
• Ability to mentor and guide engineering teams.
• Adaptability and continuous learning mindset.



Qualifications

Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Engineering or related field. MCA/M.Tech/MS preferred. Relevant certifications in Cloud, Python, React or Architecture are advantageous.
